result.title: RELAGRAM: Recursive Latent Graph Model for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
result.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 MLxOR workshop. Paper contains 6 pages (4 main text, 1 references, 1 appendix); 1 figure and 3 tables
result.summary: Latent recursion repeatedly processes internal representations through the same neural network. Recent work has shown this approach to be effective on structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. However, whether latent recursion can support neural routing remains unclear. We introduce RELAGRAM (Recursive Latent Graph Model), a novel approach that brings latent recursion to graph combinatorial optimization. RELAGRAM encodes a capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) instance as edge tokens; a compact transformer recurrently updates the latent representations of these tokens. An output head maps the answer state to an edge heatmap, from which an autoregressive decoder constructs a feasible solution. On CVRP-100 instances, the 0.53M-parameter RELAGRAM achieves gaps to a PyVRP reference of 13.4%, 9.8%, and 8.3% under greedy decoding, eightfold symmetry augmentation, and 256-candidate search, respectively. Trained only on CVRP-100, RELAGRAM generalizes zero-shot to CVRP-500 and CVRP-1000, achieving gaps of 15.6% and 21.7% under 256-candidate search. Together, these results demonstrate that latent recursion is a promising approach to neural routing.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将 latent recursion 引入图组合优化：把 CVRP 实例编码为边 token，用紧凑 transformer 反复更新其 latent 表示，输出头得到边热图后由自回归解码器构造可行解，并检验在更大规模实例上的零样本泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽不涉及视觉或多模态，但其「同一网络递归更新 latent 状态、再由答案状态解码」的循环计算设计，以及按问题规模零样本泛化的评测，可能为 LVR 的 latent 递归深度、状态更新与长度泛化提供可核查的方法线索。
